editorial.blurb: Ascione Bistro Hyde Park is a proudly owned Italian restaurant where the chef and owner personally ensure every dish—from lobster ravioli to perfectly cooked Fiorentina steak—arrives at your table with care and precision.
editorial.insiderTip: Mention your desired dish to the chef when you arrive; the kitchen may send out a taste before you officially order, as they did with the lobster ravioli for one delighted guest.
